candidates.title: ✅ The PERFECT Overhead DB Tricep Extension
candidates.description:
✅ The PERFECT Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension

1️⃣ Adjust Your Seat Position – Slide your butt slightly forward on the shoulder press seat so your torso leans back. This sets you up for better arm positioning in the next step.

2️⃣ Angle Your Upper Arms Slightly Back – Instead of keeping them completely vertical, let your upper arms tilt slightly backward. This adjustment keeps constant tension on your triceps and increases the effective range of motion, allowing you to lower the dumbbell further.

3️⃣ Tuck Your Elbows – Keep your elbows close to your head rather than flaring them out. This maintains tension on the triceps and reduces unnecessary strain on your elbows.

4️⃣ Maximize Your Range of Motion – Lower the dumbbell as far as your mobility allows to fully stretch your triceps for more gains.

candidates.title: Kettlebell Technique - Complex with Overhead Press/Tricep Extension
candidates.description:
Complex Technique

Sometimes when move from one movement into the next we find little ways to make it easier and is not always with the best form. (Also when going heavier we add in cheat spots to get us through ;)… it happens ) We need to be mindful of our form throughout , sometimes if we are using a cheat it’s an indicator that we need to go down in our weight and build up our strength so that we can execute good form. Today looking at the overhead press into the tricep extension. The spot I want you to concentrate on is finishing the press before going into the tricep extension. Slow it done and if you have a mirror you can visually watch your form! Keep at it!!!!
